title: Format page
description: Lathe's record format: how records are kept, then an index of the kinds by stage and folder, the relations and the checks by severity.

title: Kind page
description: What the reference says about one kind, its columns included, in the workbench, with the kind's facts in the side bar.

title: Check page
description: One check's severity, explanation, query and the problems it reports now, in the workbench, with the check's facts in the side bar.

title: Checks page
description: A space's Checks page: every problem of its product, errors first, grouped by check, then the workspace's under Workspace.

title: Specs menu
description: The left menu: a rail with one icon per product (each product a space), and a panel listing the current space's domains with their capabilities.

title: Domain page
description: The domain's one page, at its ID: its description, its records grouped by stage, a search box, and the domain's coverage (designed, built and proved), gaps and problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the side bar.

title: Record page
description: One record: its text fields rendered as Markdown, its part rows and other fields, parent and children, links out and in grouped by relation, and its problems.

title: Graph view
description: The whole model as one map, shown as the Graph view of an address and focused on that record (or a group of the graph's tree, at its address): laid out left to right in columns by depth in the parent/child tree, like a folder tree, every parent as tall as its children and every sibling in one column, children grouped by kind, each kind drawn in its own shape (a domain a hexagon). The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth asks for; a breadcrumb trail, a depth switch, a Links switch, a trace mode switch, kind and relation filters, a minimap, and a side bar for the focused record with a legend sit around it.

title: Model view
description: The ERD of a domain at aggregate level (at `/<domain-id>?view=model`), of an aggregate's entities, or of an entity's aggregate with the entity picked out, as a pane beside the wiki and the graph, with a key under it.

title: Product page
description: The product's one page, at its ID: its body, its domains as cards with coverage bars (designed, built and proved), its summary of what Lathe counts across it, its open questions and its problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the side bar.
